name: @fdpm-plugins/academic-paper-v0-4-1
description: Academic paper plugin v0.4.1 — the sole academic-paper profile since the v0.3 plugin was withdrawn (2026-08-29). Adds two transitive cycle-detection rules (Claim.supersededBy + Quotation.translatedFrom) and a translatedFrom self-loop check on top of the 33 declared rules, bringing the typed-graph integrity layer to parity with the rev3 SHACL mirror. Primitives are prefixed `acad:`.
